title: D&D Playground Logic
summary: This module provides core logic for a D&D playground feature, enabling retrieval of specific configuration details like alpha values and best cell configurations based on a given corner identifier. It acts as a backend for user-facing playground interfaces.

nodes.label: Get Corner Alphas
nodes.title: Retrieve Alpha Values for Corner
nodes.description: Extracts and returns the 'alpha_a' and 'alpha_b' float values from the best cell configuration associated with a given corner ID.

nodes.label: Get Best Cell Configuration
nodes.title: Retrieve Best Cell for Corner
nodes.description: Fetches the complete best cell configuration dictionary for a specified corner ID, utilizing an internal helper function.

nodes.label: Determine Best Cell
nodes.title: Internal Best Cell Logic
nodes.description: An internal utility function that processes a corner's data structure to identify and return the 'best' cell configuration based on internal criteria. It's called by public functions.

nodes.label: Corner Configurations Data
nodes.title: Predefined Corner Data
nodes.description: A global or module-level dictionary (`corners`) storing predefined configurations for various 'corners', used as input for retrieving specific cell data.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Stream API
nodes.title: Stream D&D Playground Data
nodes.description: User-facing API endpoint (`app.main.dnd_playground_stream`) responsible for streaming D&D playground data, likely consuming the logic provided by this module.

groups.label: D&D Playground Logic
groups.title: Core D&D Playground Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the core business logic for retrieving specific configurations and alpha values related to D&D playground corners.

groups.label: Configuration Data
groups.title: D&D Corner Configuration Data
groups.description: External or module-level data store containing predefined configurations for various D&D playground corners.

groups.label: Playground Interfaces
groups.title: User-Facing D&D Playground API
groups.description: Provides user-facing API endpoints for interacting with the D&D playground features, likely consuming the logic from this module.
